name: SPX Technologies, Inc.
summary: SPX Technologies, Inc. engages in the supply of engineered solutions serving the heating, ventilation, and cooling (HVAC); and detection and measurement markets in the United States, Canada, China, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, HVAC and Detection and Measurement. The HVAC segment engineers, designs, manufactures, installs, and services package and process cooling products and engineered air movement and handling solutions for the industrial, institutional, and commercial HVAC markets, as well as hydronic and electrical heating and ventilation products for the residential, industrial, institutional, and commercial markets.
